verdicts.file: Remains of Iron Age fort, Kinnoull Hill Perth, Scotland.jpg
verdicts.note: Rough ruined wall with a rectangular opening and, behind it, a round masonry tower bound by rusted iron bands; a built tower.

verdicts.file: Remains of Iron Age fort, Kinnoull Hill Perth, Scotland (8925504470).jpg
verdicts.note: Gravel path up a grassy hill to ruined stone walls and the round iron-banded tower; a later monument, not an earthwork.

verdicts.file: Remains of Iron Age fort, Kinnoull Hill Perth, Scotland (8925547398).jpg
verdicts.note: Close-up of the round tower's rusted iron straps against rough stonework with green leaves; masonry detail.

verdicts.file: Remains of Iron Age fort, Kinnoull Hill Perth, Scotland (8925512172).jpg
verdicts.note: Ruined stone walls, an interpretive bench and the round banded tower on a hilltop lawn under cloud; built tower ruins.

verdicts.file: Remains of Iron Age fort, Kinnoull Hill Perth, Scotland (8924946239).jpg
verdicts.note: Steep upward view along the round tower's stone base to its corbelled top; dressed masonry, not ramparts.

verdicts.file: Remains of Iron Age fort, Kinnoull Hill Perth, Scotland (8924906301).jpg
verdicts.note: Looking up from inside the tower: circular stone shaft with rusted iron cross-braces and open sky above the rim.

verdicts.file: California's only National Guard armored unit displays their might during maneuvers at Fort Irwin's National Training Center 111105-A-GM826-022.jpg
verdicts.note: Tan tracked armoured fighting vehicle with two helmeted soldiers in a US desert; a modern military scene.

verdicts.file: Jayne Bricknell and Michael Bradley camping in a garden at Pentre Isa, Old Colwyn (1537789).jpg
verdicts.note: Black-and-white photo of two children beside a rough plank-and-tarpaulin camp in a garden; people, no earthworks.

verdicts.file: Jayne Bricknell and Michael Bradley camping in a garden at Pentre Isa, Old Colwyn (1537790).jpg
verdicts.note: Black-and-white photo of a boy and girl by a plank-and-tarp camp among bushes and rubble; a modern garden scene.

verdicts.file: Jayne Bricknell and Michael Bradley camping in a garden at Pentre Isa, Old Colwyn (1537791).jpg
verdicts.note: Black-and-white photo of two children kneeling at a makeshift plank camp among garden plants; not a fort.
